title: 九个不同服装姿势和表情的Q版贴纸
prompt: Create a 3D kawaii 10:16 canvas featuring nine chibi-style stickers in various outfits, poses, and expressions. Use the attached image for reference. Each sticker has a white border and includes a speech bubble with phrases like "Goodmorning", "Lunch kana", "Huh", "Hugs", "Thank you", "Goodnight", "You're the best" "miss you" "mwah 😙" "good job" and "Ingat ka". Set on a soft white-to-pastel blue gradient background for a fun, positive vibe.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松制作九款 Q 版贴纸，搭配多样服装、姿势和表情，打造时尚可爱的 3D 风格，适合数字手工、社交媒体分享或传递积极信息。
